name: Building Skills
short_description: Group, move, copy and mirror your factory. Plan rail networks, extend spline placement, and undo construction or dismantling.
author: sgachoud
network_activity_transparency: Building Skills makes no external network requests and includes no telemetry or online AI service. Multiplayer communication uses the game's client/server networking to synchronize mod actions and plans. Documentation and support links open the external GitHub website when clicked.
ai_usage_transparency: OpenAI Codex was used to help develop source code, build and test scripts, documentation, release notes, and this mod page. It also helped create the mod's UI/content setup and the original geometric icon and promotional artwork. Gameplay previews are real recordings supplied by the mod author, trimmed and converted to GIF with Codex-assisted scripts; they are not generated gameplay. Building Skills does not use generative AI at runtime.
